text_block_list.text:
Марузенски is training hard for the
upcoming
Tenno Sho in the fall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, a press conference is
held for
the Umamusume who will run in
the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Among them is Спешл Уик, who has
always
watched Марузенски from a
distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally able to challenge one another in
the
greatest of arenas, Марузенски
smiles with
unconcealed joy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
